verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a PR review automation that watches for a configurable label, inspects the full PR context, and posts an AI review comment. Its general automation engine can also run on GitHub webhook events, so reviewing every PR is plausibly configurable. However, the documented flow is label-triggered rather than automatic on every PR, and it posts a single review comment rather than inline line-level comments. Missing for 10: documented automatic review of every PR without a label trigger, inline per-line AI comments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
